g.text: Rig node list and pivot points (Dot front view, model height 4.25 HH)
child of head, 1-2 frame overlap on turns
head pivot = base of skull at the neck
Joint rule: child overlaps parent by ≥ 0.15 limb width, with a hidden cap
Draw order, back to front: far arm > far leg > torso > near leg > head (hair back, skull, eyes, lids, brows, nose, mouth, fringe) > near arm. Flipping mirrors the whole tree.
